title: Detection of Bacterial Pathogens and Drug Resistance Markers Using Rolling Circle Amplification
author: Malte Kühnemund
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zp8f5rw
materials: If the initial concentration of samples is higher than 100 femtomolar, pipette a 5-10 µL drop on a Superfrost Microscope Slide (Thermofisher) and put a 24x24 mm cover slip (Menzel) on top to spread it. Incubate the slide at room temperature for 00:10:00 and you can proceed to image using fluorescence microscopy. 10x or 20x objectives are recommended. If the concentration is lower than 100 femtomolar, microfluidic enrichment is required.

steps.title: Dilute padlock probes
steps.instruction: Dilute the padlock probes (PLP) to a final concentration of 10 nM. Prepare a fresh 10 nM dilution for each experiment.

steps.title: Denature extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Heat the extracted DNA from the culture isolate or clinical sample at 95 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00), then immediately place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Prepare ligation master mix and ligate
steps.instruction:
Prepare a ligation master mix for the total number of reactions required (no beads). Use the following component concentrations and volumes (per reaction):
- Target DNA: 10 units (final conc. 1 × 10⁻⁴ M?)
- PLP mix: 10 nM (stock 100 pM), add 0.2 µL to reach 4.8 µL final volume
- BSA: 2 µg/µL, streptavidin‑fluorophore (stf) 0.2 µg/µL (add 2 µL)
- Ampligase Buffer 10×: add 48 µL (final 1×)
- Ampligase enzyme: 5 U/µL stock, add 0.25 U/µL to obtain 0.5 U total (12 µL)
- H₂O: add 5.3 µL (to reach a total mix volume of 20 µL; overall master‑mix volume 240 µL for 12 reactions)

Mix the master mix thoroughly. Add 10 µL of this master mix to each assay tube, then add 10 µL of the denatured DNA from Step 2. Incubate the assay tubes as follows:
- 95 °C for 30 seconds (00:00:30)
- 55 °C for 40 minutes (00:40:00).

substeps.instruction: Prepare the master mix with the listed reagents and volumes.
Aliquot 10 µL master mix into each tube and add 10 µL denatured DNA.
Incubate at 95 °C for 30 s then at 55 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Prepare RCA mix and amplify
steps.instruction:
Prepare a rolling‑circle amplification (RCA) master mix for the total number of reactions required using the following components (per reaction):
- Circular DNA template: 20 units
- dNTPs: 2.5 mM stock, add to reach 125 µM final (1.5 µL)
- Phi29 buffer 10×: add 3 µL (final 1×)
- BSA: 2 µg/µL, stf 0.2 µg/µL (add 3 µL)
- Phi29 polymerase: 10 U/µL stock, add 1.2 µL to give 400 mU/µL final (28.8 µL total polymerase volume)
- H₂O (mQ): add 1.3 µL (31.2 µL total water)
- Adjust volumes to reach a mix volume of 30 µL per reaction (overall master‑mix volume 240 µL for 8 reactions)

Add 10 µL of this RCA master mix to each tube containing the ligation reaction from Step 3. Incubate the tubes as follows:
- 37 °C for 3 hours (03:00:00)
- 65 °C for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

Note 1: Longer amplification times yield longer products and stronger signals; phi29 polymerase remains active up to 12 h. For microscopy, 1 h is sufficient; for microfluidic enrichment, ≥ 2 h is recommended.
Note 2: Ampligase buffer can replace the phi29 buffer if volumes are adjusted accordingly.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the RCA master mix with the listed reagents and volumes.
Add 10 µL RCA mix to each ligation tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 3 h then at 65 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Prepare labeling mix and label
steps.instruction:
Prepare a labeling mix for the total number of reactions required using the following components (per reaction):
- Labelling mix 1×: 15 µL
- S02383 probe: 1 µM stock, add to reach 5 nM final (0.3 µL, 7.2 µL total?)
- S00852 probe: 1 µM stock, add to reach 5 nM final (0.3 µL, 7.2 µL total?)
- MQ H₂O: 14.4 µL (to reach a mix volume of 30 µL; overall master‑mix volume 720 µL for 24 reactions)
- Total volume per reaction after addition: 60 µL (30 µL mix + 30 µL RCA product)

Add 30 µL of this labeling mix to each tube containing the RCA reaction from Step 4. Incubate the tubes as follows:
- 75 °C for 2 minutes (00:02:00)
- 55 °C for 15 minutes (00:15:00).

Note 3: For optimal microfluidic enrichment, filter the labeling mix through a 0.1 µm Millipore filter to remove fluorophore aggregates or crystals that could cause background.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the labeling master mix with the listed reagents and volumes.
Add 30 µL labeling mix to each RCA tube.
Incubate at 75 °C for 2 min then at 55 °C for 15 min.
Filter the labeling mix through a 0.1 µm filter before use (optional but recommended).
